prose: A second Hacker News link to the Krea 3 launch: an image-editing model the vendor says changes only what you ask, finishes edits in about 8 seconds and costs about $0.06 per image, far faster and cheaper than GPT Image 2 and Nano Banana Pro. These are the vendor's claims.
highlights: Krea 3 claims ~8s edits at ~$0.06 per image.
Same launch as the earlier Krea 3 item.
